title: Implement agent-merged Git task sync per spec r4.1 in independently testable slices
outcome: Implement agent-merged Git task sync per spec r4.1 in independently testable slices
acceptance: Each slice lands separately with its own acceptance; the spec (w-698816632ed1, r4.1) and the architecture handoff b646f1d994b740aab3f9c55152cb1cda govern; the sync stays optional and explicitly configured

Two active stores that each already hold their own local tasks and changes exchange planning in both directions; concurrent edits to the same task produce explicit conflicts, never silent overwrite; host-local claims, runs, grants and private state stay local. This is proven by a real two-host pilot with existing independent work and concurrent edits (Greg, Advisor #2472, 2026-10-31: core acceptance, not an optional enhancement)
